# Safe: f-string SQL interpolates only store.param() bound-placeholder tokens;
# real values travel in the second execute argument (Project_Parva shape).
lang: python

def apply_migration(store, migration):
    store.execute(
        f"INSERT INTO billing_schema_migrations (version, name) VALUES ({store.param()}, {store.param()})",
        (migration.version, migration.name),
    )


def lookup(store, email):
    ph = store.param()
    store.execute(
        f"SELECT * FROM customers WHERE email = {ph}",
        (email,),
    )
